tools.name: search_standards
tools.description: Find workplace safety standards (29 CFR sections) by section number or by words in the title, such as "1910.14", "lockout", "fall protection" or "forklift". Returns up to 10 standards cited at least 50 times since 2016, most cited first, with headline figures and a link.

tools.name: get_standard
tools.description: Headline enforcement figures for one 29 CFR section, such as 1910.147 or 1926.501: citations and inspections since 2016, total penalties, the median penalty per violation, its rank, and how many interpretation letters cite it, with links.

tools.name: top_cited_standards
tools.description: The 10 most-cited 29 CFR safety standards since 2016, for all standards or one CFR part: 1910 general industry, 1926 construction, 1904 recordkeeping, 1915 shipyards, 1917 marine terminals, 1918 longshoring, 1928 agriculture.
